import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from xgboost import XGBClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import os

# Read sample submission template
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")
submission_path = "./submission/submission.csv"
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(submission_path), exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

print(f"Training data shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test data shape: {test_df.shape}")

# Prepare labels and texts
texts = train_df["comment_text"]
labels = train_df[
    ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]
]

# Split into train/val (hold out ~20% for validation)
texts_train, texts_val, labels_train, labels_val = train_test_split(
    texts,
    labels,
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=[l for l in labels if l != 0],
)

# Create vectorsizer and fit on full training data
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    stop_words="english", ngram_range=(1, 2), max_features=20000
)
vectorizer.fit(texts_train)

X_train = vectorizer.transform(texts_train)
X_val = vectorizer.transform(texts_val)
X_test = vectorizer.transform(test_df["comment_text"])

# Initialize multiple models for each target class
model_params = {
    col: {
        "n_estimators": 500,
        "max_depth": 5,
        "learning_rate": 0.1,
        "subsample": 0.8,
        "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
    }
}

models = {}
for col in ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]:
    model = XGBClassifier(
        class_weight="balanced", **model_params[col], use_label_encoder=False
    )
    model.fit(
        X_train,
        labels_train[col],
        eval_set=[(X_val, labels_val[col]), (X_train, labels_train[col])],
    )
    models[col] = model

# Generate predictions on test set
preds = []
for col in ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]:
    prob = models[col].predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
    preds.append(prob)
preds = np.column_stack(preds)

# Create submission dataframe
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_df["id"],
        "toxic": preds[0],
        "severe_toxic": preds[1],
        "obscene": preds[2],
        "threat": preds[3],
        "insult": preds[4],
        "identity_hate": preds[5],
    }
)

# Save submission
submission_df.to_csv(submission_path, index=False)
print(f"Saved submission to {submission_path}")

# Calculate hold-out validation metric (column-wise ROC AUC)
valid_preds = np.column_stack([m.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1] for m in models.values()])
valid_labels = labels_val.values

metrics = {}
for i, col in enumerate(
    ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]
):
    metric = roc_auc_score(valid_labels[:, i], valid_preds[i])
    metrics[col] = metric
    print(f"{col} ROC-AUC (validation): {metric:.4f}")

mean_auc = np.mean(list(metrics.values()))
print(f"\nMean Column-wise ROC AUC (Validation): {mean_auc:.4f}")
